jobs.description:
Vinçotte is the market leader in Belgium and offers objective and advisory services in inspection, certification, conformity assessment and training. Our team of over 1,500 professionals is committed to a safer and more efficient society. Our sector specialists understand the needs of customers perfectly and guide them along the way with advice and support. Aiming for results for multinationals, SMEs, self-employed persons and private persons is what makes our blood flow. We are looking for a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) to join our team in Vilvoorde.

Ready to level up your career and secure the digital world? As a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) you’ll be the go-to expert managing our network and security infrastructure – across our campus, datacenter, and Microsoft Azure environment.

What will you do?

• Take charge of our network & security landscape, both on-prem and in the cloud (Azure).
• Provide Level 2 support for complex IT network issues.
• Dive into IT projects related to your area of expertise.
• Work autonomously in an agile setup with a clear backlog and strategic focus.
• Help improve documentation and technical guidelines.
• Detect, assess, and fix security risks – you're our digital guardian.
• Manage and fine-tune spam filters to keep our communications safe.

Experience:

• You've already rolled up your sleeves in network and firewall management — think design, setup, config, upgrades — and you know your way around operational environments.
• You’re certified in Azure, have experience with it, or you're eager to dive in and grow into a true Azure pro.
• You’re ready to become our in-house expert on Microsoft Security tools — managing, fine-tuning, and pushing them to keep cyber threats out.
• You're curious about Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and see it as a powerful tool in building fast, scalable, modern environments.
• You believe solid processes are the backbone of great IT — and you embrace ITIL best practices to keep things running smoothly and smartly.
• You hold an IT bachelor degree and have 2-3 years of relevant experience in the following domains:
• Routing & Switching: Aruba and / or Cisco
• Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) : Fortinet, Check Point or Palo Alto
• Reverse Proxy : BlueCoat, Fortiweb or Azure Application GW
• SASE/SDWAN: CATO, Fortinet, zScaler or Pallo Alto
• Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) CATO and / or zScaler
• Cloud Networking & Security: Azure 
• Network Access Control (802.1X Wired/Wireless, RADIUS, TACACS, Guest Portals)
• Vulnerability management: Nessus, MS Defender or Qualys
• Network Detection and Response (NDR): Darktrace 
• Extended Detection and Response (XDR): MS Defender and / or Sentinelone, 
• Spam filtering: MS Defender, Barracuda or Cisco Ironport 

Personality:

• You don’t wait around — when something’s blocking the business, you jump in and fix it fast.
• You’re all about progress: positive mindset, always learning, always improving, and staying sharp on the latest tech trends.
• Agile is your jam — you thrive in sprints, love a good retro, and believe great things happen when teams grow together.
 

Languages:

• Dutch or French? Check. English? No problem — you’re fluent in the language of international teamwork.

For a client in Duffel we are looking for a temporary 
Customer Service Representative.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• You process customer orders accurately, efficiently, and in a timely manner, while closely following up to ensure excellent customer service. 

• You respond to customer inquiries and emails and ensure smooth communication with clients. 

• You manage metal contracts and related administration. 

• You handle customer complaints in a professional and solution-oriented way. 

• You support the sales team with efficient administrative organization to guarantee continuity and high-quality customer support.  

 

Profile
 
 

• You hold at least a bachelor’s degree, preferably in a commercial or administrative field. 

• You have an excellent command of English and German. Additional languages are considered a plus. 

• You are comfortable working with Microsoft Office applications; knowledge of SAP is an advantage. 

• Experience in or affinity with an industrial environment is a strong asset. 

• You are stress-resistant and able to work efficiently under pressure. 

• You are customer-oriented, communicative, and a good listener. 

• You are proactive, persistent, and able to think creatively when solving problems.

What you will do
 

As a Supply Chain Solution Manager for Full Turn Key ASIC (application specific integrated circuit) production within imec.IC-link, you will serve as the critical interface between international customers and our ecosystem of semiconductor foundries, assembly houses, and test facilities. You take up responsibility for the full production, planning and on-time-delivery. This is a new position, to support the growing complexity of our Full Turn Key ASIC programs.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Overall planning related to wafer production, assembly, and test activities. 

• Defining the supply chain flow and managing the official handover of projects from the engineering team to the production team. 

• Monitoring production milestones and ensuring on-time delivery. 

• Aligning with the Production team lead on project status and priorities. 

• Monthly alignment with sales, account managers, and team lead on customer forecasts and subcontractor capacities. 

• Daily follow-up and update of production deliveries using IMEC’s WIP (Work-in-Progress) database system. 

• Reviewing incoming purchase orders from customers and generating corresponding purchase orders for subcontractors. 

• Coordinating global shipments to subcontractors and end customers. 

• Managing complex projects involving dynamic customer rolling forecasts and evolving subcontractor capacities. 

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field. 

• You bring 5 to 8 years of experience in supply chain operations, preferably in the semiconductor, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing industry. 

• You are highly organized, accurate, and proactive, with strong skills in production planning, supplier coordination, and customer communication. 

• You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and Power BI for data analysis and reporting. 

• Diplomatic and with strong communication skills, you engage stakeholders in meeting deadlines, adhering to quality standards and achieving goals within budget. 

• You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and enjoy working closely with engineering, operations, and customer-facing teams. 

• You are fluent in English (written and spoken). Knowledge of other languages is a plus.

‎ 

Client Details

Our client is a globally admired design-driven company. They're based in the North of Brussels and looking for an AR Accountant to strengthen the team.

Description

• Follow up on Customer Accounts
• Intervene when there are issues with invoices
• Be a contact person for clients
• Make reports on blocked orders
• Be a part of the AR / AP Accounting team

• 2-3 years of experience in Accounting / Credit Control

• Problem solving, hands-on mentality

Bier Central Brussels is the place where beer lovers can indulge their passion.

With 
over 300 beers on the menu, warm hospitality, and a kitchen that satisfies every appetite, we’re a staple in the heart of Brussels—just a stone’s throw from 
Brussels Central Station.
 

 
 

Our passionate team is looking for a 
new colleague (Flexi) who shares our enthusiasm and energy to join our bustling establishment.
 

 
 

As a server/bartender, you are the face of our business. You ensure that every guest feels welcome and enjoys 
smooth, friendly service.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Welcoming guests and guiding them to their table 

• Presenting the menu and providing additional explanations where necessary 

• Advising customers on their choice of food and drinks 

• Serving drinks and food 

• Clearing tables and ensuring a tidy environment 

• Helping to maintain general hygiene 

• Working in both the bar and the restaurant (no worries we’ll be happy to train you) 

We are looking for candidates who are 
willing to work hard, don’t like standing still, and are 
eager to work. 
 

 
 

-> 
Don't have that much 
experience in the hospitality industry yet? That's no problem—we'd be happy to teach you the ropes. As long as you're in 
good physical shape, there are plenty of opportunities.
 

 
 

Since we’re located in the heart of the capital, knowing a few 
languages is definitely helpful. The languages most commonly spoken here are 
Dutch, English, and French. It’s therefore no small advantage to be fluent in at least two of these languages.
 

 
 

Since closing time is around 11 p.m. to midnight, it’s convenient if you 
live nearby (i.e., within walking or biking distance, but not too dependent on public transportation—and definitely not on a car; parking in Brussels won’t make you any richer).

The 
Safety Assistant is responsible for ensuring the maintenance of aviation safety standards throughout the organisation. Their primary duties encompass the verification of compliance with established safety procedures and regulatory requirements, the execution of routine safety inspections, and the comprehensive investigation of incidents. 

Through the systematic monitoring of adherence to safety protocols and the provision of support during audit processes, the Safety Assistant makes a significant contribution to the establishment and preservation of a secure working environment, whilst facilitating the proactive identification and mitigation of potential safety hazards.
 

The Safety Assistant will be reporting to the Quality Manager.
 

Job Responsibilities
• Retrieve CCTV footage upon explicit request

• Conduct safety checks as prescribed by the BCAA

• Participate in incident investigations, prepare investigation reports, and develop

corrective actions in collaboration with operational management

• Follow up and implement safety procedures

• Monitor and address employees regarding safety practices

• Investigate aviation safety incidents

• Provide support during (safety) audits

• Assist in reporting incidents to the relevant authorities

• Take over tasks in the absence of QHSE

• Follows clearly prescribed internal and external safety rules (SOP/LOP)

• The position is primarily assigned to one station in Belgium, but the employee is

required to work at other stations when necessary

• Ensure compliance with safety rules

• Investigate and provide administrative follow-up on incidents

• Formal contact with external parties to ensure the execution and adherence to safety

rules

• Contact with all relevant internal parties to ensure the application of safety rules

• Contact with BCAA regarding deviations, incidents, questions, and reports

• Ensure compliance with environmental legislation and apply internal environmental

policies and procedures as part of daily responsibilities

• Safety driven
 

• Knowledge of BCAA and airport regulations
 

• Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office
 

• Basic understanding of audits
 

• Flexibility in working hours, including occasional weekend and night shifts
 

• At least 12 months of experience in aviation
 

• Ability to communicate fluently (verbal and written) in French, Dutch, and English
 

• Ability to provide information and explain procedures

jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

At BNP Paribas Fortis, Identity & Access Management (IAM) is where security meets innovation. We're transforming how the bank manages access rights, making it smarter, more secure, and future-proof.

As part of our IAM Evolution Squad, you'll help build a modern, compliance-driven identity framework using SailPoint and CyberArk.

You'll join a 10-person team of Business Analysts, Security Officers, Product Owner, and Scrum Master based in Montagne Du Parc.

Here, you won't just maintain security, you'll shape its future.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As our Privileged Access Management (PAM) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the driving force behind designing, implementing, and optimizing our PAM solutions.

You'll ensure our security not only meets the highest standards but also evolves with the future.

 

What will you actually do?

• You'll develop and implement access policies that meet strict security and regulatory requirements. You'll guide the evolution of our IAM systems, working closely with IT and business teams to ensure security never comes at the expense of efficiency.
• You'll share your knowledge and train teams in best practices, because strong security starts with everyone who uses it. And you'll optimize processes using KPIs and continuous improvement because security is never truly "done".
• You'll collaborate with IAM specialists and cross-functional teams (IT Security, Infrastructure, Compliance, Risk) to strengthen our security controls. You'll make sure we're always one step ahead.
 

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• You have a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree and are CISSP-certified (or have equivalent experience).
• You bring 10+ years of security experience, with deep knowledge of PAM (CyberArk) and a strong background in IAM, Segregation of Duties, and Role-Based Access Control. You're familiar with SailPoint and Cloud (IaaS/PaaS).
 

But what really sets you apart? 

• You think strategically and analytically: complexity is a challenge, not a barrier.
• You're persuasive and collaborative: you bring teams together and drive decisions forward.
• You're proactive and resilient: thriving in dynamic environments.
• You work with precision and structure, because quality is non-negotiable.
• And you love working in multicultural teams, because diversity is your strength.
• You speak Dutch & French: because we're based in Belgium.
• You are fluent in English (written & spoken): the language of global security.
• Your toolkit: CyberArk ServiceNow SailPoint Process Management tools – the tools you'll use every day.

Join an international company operating (logistics sector), based in Nivelles, as a Junior Supply Chain Graduate and gain exposure to planning, inventory management, logistics coordination, and continuous improvement projects. This is an opportunity for a recent graduate to develop key supply chain skills, work with experienced professionals, and build a long-term career in an international environment.

Informations sur l'entreprise

 Our client based in Nivelles is an international and fast-growing company operating in the logistics and supply chain sector. Renowned for its collaborative culture, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to talent development, the company offers an excellent environment for young professionals looking to launch their career in Supply Chain.

To strengthen their operations team, they are currently looking for a motivated Junior Supply Chain Graduate eager to learn, grow, and gain exposure to end-to-end supply chain activities.

 

Missions

As a Junior Supply Chain Graduate, you will support various supply chain functions and gain valuable hands-on experience across planning, logistics, inventory management, and operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting demand planning and forecasting activities
• Monitoring inventory levels and helping optimize stock availability
• Coordinating with suppliers, warehouses, and transportation partners
• Tracking deliveries and ensuring smooth order fulfillment
• Assisting with data analysis and preparing supply chain performance reports
• Identifying operational improvement opportunities and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders such as Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics, and Operations
• Participating in supply chain projects related to process optimization, digitalization, and performance enhancement
• Ensuring accurate data management within ERP and supply chain systems
• Contributing to the achievement of service, quality, and cost objectives

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Engineering, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field
• Recent graduate or first professional experience within Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, or Planning
• Strong analytical mindset with good problem-solving abilities
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
• Comfortable working with data and supply chain KPIs
• Eager to learn and develop within an international environment
• Organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with different stakeholders
• Team player with a positive and hands-on attitude

Software Engineer Vacancy
 

Are you passionate about building innovative digital solutions? Devatwork is looking for a talented Fullstack Engineer to join our dynamic team. If you think you are a match, we want to hear from you!
 

What You'll Do:
 

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications
 

● Develop both front-end and back-end solutions
 

● Communicate with clients to understand their pain points and offer solutions
 

● Ensure optimal performance, security, and responsiveness across all platforms
 

● Work with cloud services and databases
 

● Be a leader in your field, and help others grow with you
 

What We're Looking For:
 

● Strong proficiency in Full Stack Development
 

● Have at least 2 years of professional experience
 

● Experience with React, Vue.js, Angular, or similar front-end frameworks
 

● Solid knowledge of Node.js, Django, Laravel, or other back-end technologies
 

● Knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases
 

● Knowledge of version control systems (git or others)

 

● Be able to work on multiple projects simultaneously

 

● Ability to master technologies/tools on request

 

● Understanding of Enterprise Level Architectures

 

● English speaking, Dutch or French are strong assets

 

● Be open to be working in Ghent, Belgium 4 days a week in the office

 

Preferred Skills:
 

● Experience leading small teams

 

● Understanding of DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines is a plus

 

● Knowledge of CMS Solutions (Drupal, WordPress and others)

At Michael Page, you'll do much more than recruit. You'll act as a partner for both clients and candidates, helping businesses grow while changing careers and lives. This role offers an exciting combination of talent acquisition, consulting, and business development.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Working at Michael Page means joining an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment where consultants are empowered to develop their own client portfolio, advise businesses on talent strategies, and make a real impact on people's careers. The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

Omschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.
• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from job briefing to offer negotiation.
• Provide expert advice to clients on market trends and hiring strategies.
• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.
• Ensure a high standard of service delivery to both clients and candidates.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French OR Dutch.
• Passion for sales, recruitment, and business development
• A proactive mindset.
